messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING maya (oncall) — streaming SSE channels showing increased p99 tail and intermittent chunk silence. Severity: P2. See /incidents/4432107777 for details.

maya (oncall): acked. I'm watching. initial numbers: p95 up ~2x, p99 from ~800ms -> 3.1s on streaming routes; number of client reconnects spiked. Starting triage.

sorin: I can help — any specific proxy or region?

maya (oncall): EU region first, proxy fleet eu-proxy-02 shows lots of `upstream write timeout` in logs around 4432107700-4432107760. Affected routes: /v1/stream/generation and /v1/chat/stream (SSE).

lee: grabbing proxy logs now. `kubectl logs -n infra eu-proxy-02 -c proxy --since=10m`

lee: pasted a snippet: ```
ERROR proxy/handler.go:219 write downstream failed: write tcp 10.0.4.12:8080->10.1.2.45:51432: i/o timeout
WARN proxy/stream.go:98 stalled chunk for session=ch_8uQv time=1200ms
```

maya (oncall): that matches client observations — we see a lot of "silent gaps" between SSE events, clients hitting browser reconnect. Potentially buffer/flush/keepalive issue or backpressure hitting the proxy write buffer.

emily: Customer impact? Support dashboard shows ~12 customers with errors; highest impact: chat-prod tenant (3% of requests had reconnects in last 10m), payments-notify saw delayed receipts but still delivered.

support-bot: Notifying CSE and account owners for chat-prod and payments-notify. Template message queued.

maya (oncall): Quick checks: 1) are proxies near file/socket limits? 2) any recent deploys to streaming runtime? 3) upstream model-serving latencies?

lee: node stats: `netstat -an | grep ESTAB | wc -l` shows 9.8k established on eu-proxy-02 (normal cap ~10k). ulimit is fine. No recent proxy deploys in last 2h. Serving tier shows small p99 blips but most latency is proxied write timeout.

sorin: Could be client backpressure + proxy flush thresholds. We have code that coalesces SSE chunks and flushes on threshold or keepalive. If keepalive timers slipped, gaps show up. Any differences in kernel TCP backpressure?

maya (oncall): I’m going to enable more verbose flush logging on eu-proxy-02 and roll a config change to reduce chunk coalescing interval to 100ms (from 500ms) for streaming route to test. Will do canary on one pod.

lee: canary patch command: ```bash
kubectl -n infra set env deploy/eu-proxy-02 PROXY_SSE_COALESCE_MS=100 --record
```

maya (oncall): applied to eu-proxy-02-canary. Monitoring metrics...

(2m later)

maya (oncall): canary looks promising: p99 for the canary pod down from 3.1s -> 1.0s, client reconnects stop for sessions hitting canary. Global still elevated — canary handles load ok.

emily: Support update: telling chat-prod that we're mitigating and will continue to monitor. ETA for wider rollback/rollout?

maya (oncall): Rolling canary to remainder of eu-proxy-02 pool with controlled 30s interval. Doing 2 pods at a time.

lee: alert: one pod failed liveness after env change, auto-restarted — investigating but rollout continues.

maya (oncall): also enabling temporary route-level fallback: if chunking gap >2s then fall back to polling mode for that session to avoid reconnects. Flipping feature flag `STREAM_FALLBACK_ON_SILENCE=true` for eu region.

sorin: good. Also let's add a defensive proxy-level keepalive (tcp keepalive 30s) on the host, and increase write buffer so backpressure less likely. I'll queue infra change.

maya (oncall): infra change ticket: INFRA-3321 created — will apply kernel keepalive changes to eu-proxy hosts during low-traffic window unless we see regression.

emily: customer impact note: chat-prod saw transient reconnects for 7m, now stabilized. Payments-notify experienced up to 1.5s delay on some messages but no lost messages. I'll send summary to affected accounts.

support-bot: Message sent to chat-prod CSE: "We observed intermittent SSE gaps causing client reconnects, mitigated by proxy config change; monitoring continues."

maya (oncall): After full rollout p95 back near baseline, p99 reduced to ~1.1s (still slightly high). Root cause hypothesis: coalescing interval + bursty client reads producing write buffer stall -> proxy write invokes TCP backpressure -> kernel timeout triggers. Need deeper kernel/socket and proxy flush tracing.

sorin: For postmortem: capture tcpdump around proxy victim, enable proxy flush tracing, and correlate with kernel-level tcp retransmits. Also check any large messages that prevented flush.

maya (oncall): handoff to sorin for next shift. Actions remaining for PM: postmortem with timeline + customer impact table; for infra: plan safe kernel keepalive rollout; for eng-runtime: add alert for SSE chunk silence (detect >1s gap per session).

sorin: taking over. I'll keep watch for 1h, will kick off tcpdump and trace capture. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya (oncall): thanks team. moving to watch mode. leaving thread for follow-ups.
